sketches.mechanism: The Maybe type and pattern matching: a function that receives love wrapped in Maybe but only pattern-matches on Nothing, making the Just case unreachable.
sketches.resonance: The type system allows for the possibility of having something, but the code only knows how to handle absence.

sketches.mechanism: The sealed interface with an exhaustive when-expression where every branch returns the same value, making distinction meaningless.
sketches.resonance: We name every kind of ending differently, but they all resolve to the same silence.
sketches.draft:
sealed interface Ending
object Fade : Ending
object Crash : Ending
object Drift : Ending

fun resolve(e: Ending): Unit = when(e) {
    is Fade -> Unit
    is Crash -> Unit
    is Drift -> Unit
}

sketches.mechanism: method_missing: an object that intercepts every message sent to it and returns self, meaning no matter what you ask of it, it gives back only itself.
sketches.resonance: Every question you put to grief returns grief; it has no other answer.
sketches.draft:
class Grief
  def method_missing(*)
    self
  end
end
